reading.body:
Sara Jacobs' AI record is nineteen dated events, almost all of them bills she sponsored or cosponsored, running from March 2025 to August 2026.

The pattern is legislative rather than financial. Fifteen of the nineteen entries are sponsorships or cosponsorships, four are recorded votes, and the summary promises money from AI company and AI-focused political committees but no such event appears in the data. The bills cluster around three subjects: incident reporting and monitoring, defense and autonomous weapons, and labor and talent effects. She sponsors some and joins others, which is the ordinary division of labor in a legislature where a member carries a few bills and signs onto many.

For AI specifically, the subject matter is governance of deployed systems rather than the compute, buildings, or power underneath them. The Defense AI Reliability and Reporting Act, the AI Incident Reporting Act, and the AI Threat Output and Monitoring Incident Containment Act all concern what happens after a model is running. Nothing here addresses data centers, electricity, or chip supply, so this record cannot speak to the grid constraint.

What it does not tell the reader: whether any of these bills became law, what the votes were on beyond yea or nay, or what positions she took in debate. The dates are latest-status dates, not introduction dates, so the sequence is not a clean chronology of when she acted.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for Sara Jacobs: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 19 events.
